description: This file defines the ModerationInformationInterface, an interface for content moderation services in Drupal, specifying methods for moderation status, revisions, workflows, and states of content entities.

methods.name: isModeratedEntity
methods.description: Checks if a given entity is moderated.

methods.name: canModerateEntitiesOfEntityType
methods.description: Checks if an entity type can have moderated entities.

methods.name: shouldModerateEntitiesOfBundle
methods.description: Checks if specific entity type and bundle should be moderated.

methods.name: isModeratedEntityType
methods.description: Checks if an entity type has at least one moderated bundle.

methods.name: getDefaultRevisionId
methods.description: Retrieves the default revision ID for a given entity.

methods.name: getAffectedRevisionTranslation
methods.description: Gets the translation affected by a revision.

methods.name: hasPendingRevision
methods.description: Checks if an entity has a pending revision.

methods.name: isLiveRevision
methods.description: Determines if an entity revision is 'live'.

methods.name: isDefaultRevisionPublished
methods.description: Checks if the default revision of an entity is published.

methods.name: getWorkflowForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow for a specific content entity.

methods.name: getWorkflowForEntityTypeAndBundle
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow for a specific entity type and bundle.

methods.name: getUnsupportedFeatures
methods.description: Gets unsupported features for an entity type.

methods.name: getOriginalState
methods.description: Gets the original or initial moderation state of an entity.
